stem: For ŷ=b₀+b₁x₁+b₂x₂ plotted as a graph in (x₁,x₂,ŷ) space, which geometrical description is correct?

options.text: It is a three-dimensional volume because three coordinate names appear.
It is a plane only when it is not a hyperplane.
It is a two-dimensional affine plane in R³, and that plane is also a hyperplane.
It is a one-dimensional line in R³ for every pair of coefficients.

assumptions: Inputs vary independently over R²; graph of the fitted scalar linear model, not a thresholded decision region.
